resolution.note: hook prints systemMessage naming asked/run model and lane-model opt-in; live krn-lane opus transcript fixture records claude-sonnet-5-5; subagent-model-hook tests pass

title: The lane model rewrite is silent and untested live
body:
Source: t-ahsmyfp delivery #1223: scripts/claude/subagent-model.ts rewrites an explicit opus/fable on a krn-lane call to the pinned model without any notice, so a probe that names opus without a lane-model: line silently runs Sonnet; only the pure function is tested (KRN-12).
Outcome: the hook prints a systemMessage naming the rewrite (asked model, run model, the lane-model: opt-in); a live krn-lane call with model opus records claude-sonnet-5-5 in its transcript, captured as a fixture.
Proof: node --test test/claude/subagent-model-hook.test.ts: pass (asserts the notice and the captured live model)
Files: scripts/claude/subagent-model.ts, test/claude/subagent-model-hook.test.ts

Live evidence 2026-11-16: a krn-lane Agent call with model opus from the lead session (466021be) recorded claude-sonnet-5-5 on both assistant turns (subagents/agent-a5cb93b9e17120e77.jsonl; fable appears only as advisorModel). The remaining work is the notice and a captured fixture.
